verification: Entry URLs supplied as retrieval starting points; no network/access check or source verification performed in this repair. The worker logs actual availability and translated searches.
retrieval_order: Reconcile held metadata/source identifiers and source-specific leads before duplicate download
Search primary indexes and registries with every assigned question query; screening is not fulltext acquisition
Resolve verified identities to publisher report/supplement/notice pages; seek lawful PMC/repository versions and authorized library access if available
Chase references/linked reports and report missing/paywalled originals, supplements and versions; do not stop at open access
Run final update at declared cutoff and reconcile both target axes/question gaps

entries.name: PubMed
entries.role: Biomedical discovery/identity and links to full text; abstract/index record is not a fulltext file
entries.query_policy: Use each requests.json queries[] Boolean seed; record actual syntax/filters/date/hit counts.

entries.name: PMC
entries.role: Lawful available fulltext HTML/PDF and supplements when present; not an exhaustive discovery source
entries.query_policy: Search title/PMCID/DOI and exact drug-condition terms after identity reconciliation.

entries.name: ClinicalTrials.gov
entries.role: Registry identity, status, posted results and linked report leads; registry is not primary-report PDF
entries.query_policy: Search printed NCT IDs plus each drug/condition question; distinguish registry results from published report.

entries.name: Europe PMC
entries.role: Index/identity, citation leads and available repository fulltexts
entries.query_policy: Translate same assigned queries and log exact query.

entries.name: WHO ICTRP
entries.role: Cross-registry discovery; availability/coverage must be recorded
entries.query_policy: Drug/condition synonyms and known registry IDs; no unsupported zero-results claim.

entries.name: EU CTIS
entries.role: EU clinical-trial public search and linked public documents
entries.query_policy: Drug/condition synonyms; record actual platform limits.

entries.name: DOI resolver and publisher
entries.role: Resolve an actual printed or already verified DOI to publisher identity/fulltext/supplements; never construct absent DOI
entries.query_policy: known-source-locations.json distinguishes copied prior identities from unverified printed leads. Verify before marking identity checked.

entries.name: DailyMed
entries.role: US product labeling context; preserve jurisdiction/product/version/date; not efficacy evidence
entries.query_policy: Exact generic ingredient/form/route; reconcile label role with official regulatory sources.

entries.name: FDA Drugs@FDA
entries.role: US approval and official labeling context; exact product/use/date required
entries.query_policy: Exact generic/product application; do not infer approval from study/book wording.

entries.name: EMA medicines
entries.role: EU official medicine assessment/product context where relevant
entries.query_policy: Exact generic/formulation/product; state jurisdiction and date.

entries.name: Conditional licensed indexes/libraries
entries.role: Embase/CENTRAL and authorized institution/library holdings only when this worker actually has permitted access
entries.query_policy: No credentials/library access supplied or assumed. Record unavailable services; continue lawful publisher/repository routes. Never bypass paywalls.
